# 1954–55 Philadelphia Warriors season

The 1954–55 NBA season was the Warriors' 9th season in the NBA. During a very early portion of the season, the Warriors played a game against the Baltimore Bullets on Halloween in 1954, winning that game 102–97 before the original Bullets team later folded operations early in the season on November 27, 1954; that game they played would ultimately end up being wiped out from the official record books for the NBA's history. If the game they played was officially kept as a part of the season's record for the Warriors, their official record would have had Philadelphia get a losing record of 34–39 instead of 33–39 for their season.
